$\Omega $ is open in $M$.
Proof

\sketch For $x\in \Omega $, the inverse-scalar estimates (4) bound $R$ on a uniform spatial neighborhood of $x$ for all $t<T$. Almost nonnegative sectional curvature bounds $|\Rm |$ there, and length distortion converts this to a fixed neighborhood in $M$ contained in $\Omega $.
